title: Cancellation and Refund Rules — KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
The holder may cancel an active KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan. When the reason is one of the plan's flat cancel reasons the refund is the full price with no fee. Otherwise, within the free-look days after the sale date with no visit used, the refund is the full price; after that the refund is the price times unused visits over visits included, less the cancellation fee, rounded to the cent; a computed refund below the minimum refund is not issued. When the plan was financed and its finance contract is active, the refund goes to Kestrel Auto Finance as lienholder and is credited to principal; otherwise it goes to the holder, within the cancellation refund business days. A refund is issued only on a plan whose status is cancelled.

## Definitions

- **Price** — the plan price on the plan record: the price paid or financed for that plan.
- **Visits included** — the plan level's prepaid visits included.
- **Unused visits** — the visits remaining on the plan at cancellation.
- **No visit used** — the plan's visit history shows no redeemed visit that has not been voided.
- **Free-look days** — counted in calendar days after the plan's sale date.

## The three refund branches

| Cancellation | Refund |
|---|---|
| Reason is one of the plan level's flat cancel reasons | The full price, with no fee |
| Any other reason, cancelled within the free-look days after the sale date and no visit used | The full price |
| Any other reason, in every other case | The price multiplied by the unused visits and divided by the visits included, less the cancellation fee; an amount below zero is taken as zero; the result is rounded to the cent once, at the end; if it is below the minimum refund, no refund is issued |

## Payee and timing

| Plan record and finance contract | Refund goes to |
|---|---|
| Plan financed, and its Kestrel Auto Finance contract is active | Kestrel Auto Finance as lienholder, credited to the principal of that contract |
| Any other case | The holder |

The refund is issued within the plan level's cancellation refund business days after the cancellation, and only on a plan whose status is cancelled. On cancellation the plan's remaining visits are forfeited.

## Worked figures (hypothetical plans)

The prices, dates and visit counts are example inputs; the cancellation fee of 25.00 and the minimum refund of 10.00 are those of every plan level.

1. **KestrelCare Maintenance Premier**, price 1299.00, 8 visits included, 5 unused, cancelled after the free look for a reason that is not a flat cancel reason: 1299.00 multiplied by 5 and divided by 8 is 811.875; less 25.00 is 786.875; rounded to the cent, the refund is 786.88.
2. **KestrelCare Maintenance Standard** bought at a renewal price of 664.05, 4 visits included, 1 unused, cancelled after the free look: 664.05 multiplied by 1 and divided by 4 is 166.0125; less 25.00 is 141.0125; rounded once to the cent, the refund is 141.01.
3. **KestrelCare Maintenance Basic**, price 549.00, sale date 2026-03-01, no visit used, cancelled on 2026-03-31, the 30th calendar day after the sale date, for a reason that is not a flat cancel reason: within the free look; the refund is the full 549.00. Cancelled on 2026-04-01 instead, the 31st day, with 3 of 3 visits unused: 549.00 less 25.00, a refund of 524.00.
4. **KestrelCare Maintenance Plus**, price 999.00, 4 of 6 visits used, cancelled because the vehicle was returned: the reason is a flat cancel reason, so the refund is the full 999.00 with no fee.
5. **Payee.** A financed plan whose Kestrel Auto Finance contract is active: the refund goes to Kestrel Auto Finance and is credited to principal. A financed plan whose finance contract is no longer active, or a plan that was not financed: the refund goes to the holder.
